newsitem.title: CHINA: First Sign says non-exclusive on Montagut knitwear.
newsitem.headline: First Sign says non-exclusive on Montagut knitwear.

text.p: First Sign International Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday the owner of the "Montagut" brandname, Bonneterie Cevenole SARL, had appointed Montagut Far East Ltd as the new sole agent for its knitwear garments in China, Hong Kong and Macau.
First Sign, which had held the exclusive right to deal in Montagut knitwear garments in China, Hong Kong and Macau, said it would continue to be an authorised distributor.
First Sign said it had not been able to reach agreement with Montagut on the minimum purchase for knitwear for the year ending June 30, 1998.
"The directors feel that the minimum knitwear purchase for the year ending 30th June, 1998 represents a substantial financial commitment for the group," the company said.
As such, Montagut Far East is appointed as the sole agent in China, Hong Kong and Macau for knitwear garments under the brandname "Montagut" on July 26, the statement said.

"The group (First Sign) will continue to enjoy all the rights under the knitwear agreement on an non-exclusive basis, but without the substantial financial commitment to make large annual purchases of knitwear from Montagut," it said.
"At this stage, the directors have been unable to ascertain the impact on the group's future results," First Sign said.
Sales of knitwear garments accounted for about 68.9 percent of First Sign's turnover for the year ended in June 1996, 59 percent in 1995 and 65.4 percent in 1994, it said.
For all Montagut products other than knitwear, First Sign remains the exclusive sole agent and licensee.
First Sign shares were down HK$0.46 or 27.9 percent to HK$1.19 in early afternoon.
